description: Header file defining the Vpx Video Decoder class for libvpx integration, including class declaration, member variables, and method signatures.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a video decoder using libvpx, supporting initialization, decoding, resetting, and managing decode targets.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video decoder with codec type, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callbacks.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of frames to preroll (8).

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for preroll (max value).

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current decode target for rendering.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles decoding at end of stream.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with a new frame, thread-safe.
